entry.note: Fresh OSM API on 2026-10-10 confirms unchanged exact Q336246 ellipse 44213122. Native +X east/slightly north, +Z south/slightly west; signed long axis and center retained, ground Y=0. The symmetric tower has no claimed surveyed front; reconstructed pixel and louvre phase is not an as-built panel schedule. Exterior height 144.4 m follows the coating supplier; owner/supplier summaries round to 144 m and original architect program says 142 m. Approximate entry, external pavilion, underground auditorium and terrain grade are excluded. Accepted plan 2 m/1 degree; replacement disabled. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
